guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Create Your C8ntinuum Account
guide.description: Open the C8ntinuum dashboard and sign in with email, a wallet or a social account. p8ints accrue to the account itself, not to any single wallet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Your Legacy p8ints
guide.description: Waitlist entries, and OG status campaign entries are credited in the dashboard.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the Social Tasks
guide.description: Connect and verify your X, Discord and Telegram accounts, then follow and join the official channels. Each task pays once at a fixed rate, and the verified X follow counts toward qualification.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check In Daily and Spin the Wheel
guide.description: The check-in runs through days 1 to 7 of Season 0 and stands in for a qualifying day if you have not bought $CTM yet. The wheel gives one spin per UTC day and never subtracts.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Buy and Hold $CTM Across Chains
guide.description: Holding is scored per chain, not on a combined balance, so positions on Ethereum, BNB Chain and Solana each earn separately and stack. A chain needs at least 5 CTM before it scores. Buy ETH, BNB or SOL on Bybit , withdraw to your own wallet, then use the widget below to move funds onto the chain you plan to hold on. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast rou
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Supply $CTM Liquidity
guide.description: Pooled positions are scored daily on their $CTM side and outweigh passive holding. Each token counts in one category only, so $CTM in a pool stops scoring as holding.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Verify NFT Ownership for Partner Drops
guide.description: Selected partner collections pay a one-time credit across three tiers, once per collection. Verify holdings through the official C8ntinuum Discord to claim the roles and matching p8ints.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Qualify Your Account
guide.description: Qualification needs two linked socials (one being the verified X follow), one completed capital or cross-chain action, and no fraud flag. Email does not count as a social. Unqualified accounts still earn, but cannot spend p8ints or appear on the leaderboard.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Share Your Referral Link
guide.description: The financial leg is live and pays a 15% referral share. The p8ints leg opens with Phase 2, covers direct referrals only, and pays when someone you referred qualifies and stays active.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
